title: Explicit Agreements
style: adult contemporary, glam metal elements, melodic power ballad, polished slick production, soaring clean melodic electric guitars, tight drums, restrained cool matter-of-fact clinical female lead vocals
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Clean chorus guitar, steady adult contemporary rhythm, clean polished drumbeat]

[Verse 1]
Two years of sessions on the clinical sheet
Mood and self-disclosure holding steady on the beat
Strong systemizing, explicit agreements in place
Instead of implicit trust we cannot trace
A recurring fear of hurting Claire in the dark
No reassessment done, just keeping the mark

[Chorus]
ADHD treated since two-thousand and thirteen
But the features of the spectrum are more clearly seen
Level one, pronounced planning, executive control
Explicit, constructed frameworks for the soul
He manages relationships through stated terms and contracts
Defined categories, tracking all the impacts

[Verse 2]
The difficulty with commitment is ego-dystonic
Compensation strategies, structured and chronic
Insight is high, he anticipates the turn
Interpretation yields so little left to learn
Barcelona holds Gabi, Sylvia's on her own
While Claire is open to a structure we have grown

[Guitar Solo]
[Glam metal melodic soaring guitar solo, sweeping scales, highly polished, energetic but perfectly controlled]

[Chorus]
ADHD treated since two-thousand and thirteen
But the features of the spectrum are more clearly seen
Level one, pronounced planning, executive control
Explicit, constructed frameworks for the soul
He manages relationships through stated terms and contracts
Defined categories, tracking all the impacts

[Outro]
I will watch the anchors shift as the distance grows
Whether openness brings the fear he shows
No reassessment since my leave began
Just a place to speak outside his plan
[Fade out on a clean, rhythmic guitar delay]
